records.notes: Public prosecutor's office (not a shelter). VWAP and VSTOP advocates provide court accompaniment, safety planning, crisis intervention, referrals, restitution help and Virginia Victims Fund applications; dedicated Domestic Violence Intervention Specialist for survivors of domestic abuse, intimate partner violence or sexual assault. VWAP/VSTOP are NOT bound by the same confidentiality standards as other victim support services (systems-based prosecution office). 24/7 hotlines: Domestic Violence 703.746.4911; Sexual Assault 703.683.7273. Page shows two hour statements: phone 'Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.' and office 'Monday through Friday from 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.'.

services.description: VSTOP domestic violence/sexual assault advocacy and Domestic Violence Intervention Specialist for survivors involved in the criminal justice process.

eligibility.details: Victims and witnesses of crime (criminal justice process in Alexandria).

records.notes: Seasonal free tax preparation site. VITA Tax Season 2025 preparation services ended April 15, 2026; the hours shown are for the 2026 filing season and are kept as raw text only (no schedules) until the next season is posted. Run by Northern Virginia CASH (NVACASH) coalition with Fairfax County DFS operational support; contact DFSVITA@FairfaxCounty.gov or 703-533-5320 (leave a message). What to bring: photo ID, all income statements (W-2, W-2G, 1099), Social Security card or ITIN letter for all family members, voided check, expense documents, Form 1095-A. ZIP from the same address on other Fairfax County pages (South County Center).
